intent: IMPLEMENT THE GATE OBLIGATION — the five fixes the gate-obligation finding names, landed as ONE coherent slice. The finding (verified this session against flow-control-spec §3, src/commands/index.ts gate/submit/undecidedEverywhere, src/flow/frame.ts's gate branch, src/store/store.ts gateProblems, and the agent-accepted grill events on 08-task-close/01-implementation-close-vocab + 07-operator-advance/01-implementation-advance): the entry gate (GATE①, grilling) is structurally mandatory but has NO machine-visible obligation — a task can be born ungated and stay invisible, a gate decision can be recorded by an agent at spawn with nothing intervening, and no write path is human-only. This task: (1) makes the entry gate visible from spawn by ending `spawn!` with a `submit!` at grill; (2) makes `gate!` human-only, generalising `goal! met`'s existing 'agent'-refusal and requiring RECORDED_BY (fail closed on the default); (3) fixes the frame's interactive seam — refuse non-TTY stdin, carry the human identity from the interact channel, and LAND on a blocked-at-gate card instead of the frame writing submit!+gate! itself; (4) pins the discipline in AGENTS.md — the operator presents the card, ONLY the human decides; (5) scripts the detection as a check rule so agent-initiated gate decisions cannot regress silently.
acceptanceCriteria: FIX-1 (entry gate visible): `spawn!` records `submitted @ grill` at the end of a TASK spawn, via the existing `submit!` (no new mechanism, no second write path, no direct store write) — the fresh task derives `blocked` and `LookBack.pendingGates` / `undecidedEverywhere` report it, so `ann next` shows the pending grill gate and `advance!` no longer says continue-leg for it; `ann run!` on it stops `blocked-at-gate` BEFORE any execute step. Tests: spawn→status blocked; spawn→next lists the pending grill gate; run! stops at the gate

FIX-2 (gate writes human-only): `gate!` refuses when the resolved initiator is the automated default ('agent'), with a named refusal in the `human-only` style `goal! met` already uses, and RECORDED_BY is REQUIRED for a gate write (fail closed on the 'agent' default); the refusal is recorded as a DECISION on this task: whether it covers BOTH gates or the grill gate only, with the rationale. Tests: `RECORDED_BY=agent ann gate! <task> grill accept` refuses and writes NOTHING; a named human succeeds and the decider is stamped on the record

FIX-3 (interactive seam): the frame's gate path refuses a NON-TTY stdin with a named error (`echo accept | ann run!` must never decide a gate) and, on a real TTY, the gate write carries the HUMAN identity from the interact channel rather than the ambient RECORDED_BY default; on the operator path `run!`/`advance!` LAND on a blocked-at-gate card the human then `gate!`s — the frame stops writing submit!+gate! on the human's behalf. Tests: non-TTY run! refuses; a TTY path stamps the human identity; run! leaves the gate undecided (no confirmed written)

FIX-4 (discipline pinned to the human): AGENTS.md carries the rule, as a hot invariant / state-protocol line — the operator presents the gate card, ONLY the human runs `gate!`, no agent (operator included) records a gate decision for the human, and the spawn ritual ends at `submit! … grill` + the card, never 'spawned + grill accepted'; the wording is concrete enough that a fresh agent cannot read it as permission to accept on the human's behalf

FIX-5 (scripted detection): a check/verify rule flags agent-initiated gate decisions — a `confirmed(rejected)` gate event whose recorded provenance is the automated default, or a `confirmed(grill)` landing in the same write burst as `created` with no intervening presentation — shipped as a rule module with tests and present in the derived registry (`ann rules`), never stated only as prose; it must not fire on this repo's grandfathered pre-cutoff history (or the grandfathering is explicit and reported)

VERIFICATION: the full suite is green with new tests per fix (spawn→blocked, the human-only refusal writing nothing, the non-TTY refusal, the check rule firing + not firing on the grandfathered baseline), `npm run typecheck` clean, `ann check` / `ann verify` clean on the live journey, flow-control-spec §3 amended in place for the gate obligation with the resource-registry reconciliation register updated, and the work committed with structured commit evidence
